The primary Lean surface spans core/primitive modules, Millennium modules, archived formalizations, catalog material, and proof transcripts; inspected archived and proof-transcript files contain inductive types, axioms, definitions, theorem statements, and explicit proof gaps.

Generated/archive/proof-transcript provenance is not a content-level exclusion criterion under FILTER-009/FILTER-010/FILTER-012; the inspected files contain unique searchable formal statements, so no safe hard exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Imscribing Grammar Lean surface, including archived and proof-transcript files because they contain unique formal declarations and theorem statements.
